scope: Reachable main history and exact staged public files; no local tool refs, untracked assets, service data, release attachments or CI logs. Audit reports are metadata, excluded from recursive own-pattern scanning.

rule_definitions.private_key_header: -----BEGIN(?: RSA| DSA| EC| OPENSSH| ENCRYPTED)? PRIVATE KEY-----
rule_definitions.private_runtime_path: Tracked path components assets/state/scratch/knowledge/_staging; config.local.toml/.env; extensions .sqlite3/.sqlite/.db/.secret/.jsonl. knowledge/.gitkeep allowed only as an empty tracked sentinel; its content is not read.

classification_policy: Exact prior blob/path/line/rule, verified LF/CRLF equivalent blob, or exact qualified current unittest AST identifier; no broad test-directory exemption.
